''See also: [[King Zakareth the Sixth Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] the Sixth is the ruler of [[Damasca]] and [[Cana]], holding titles such as [[Lord]] of the Morning and Evening [[Star]]. A powerful warrior in his sixties with gray hair and a muscular build, he is known for his commanding presence and a voice that resonates with absolute [[Authority|authority]]. His physical appearance is distinctive, featuring a black-and-gold peaked crown set with a large [[ruby]] and a scarred eye socket that has been replaced by a glowing red [[stone]] from the [[Crimson Vault]]. In combat, he utilizes dark metal armor lined with gold and rubies, a large black shield, and various weapons including a lightning spear and a staff. He is also identified as the [[Incarnation of Ragnarus]], possessing the ability to see scarlet potential within living beings. [[Zakareth]]'s reign has spanned over two decades, during which he has navigated significant political and supernatural crises, including wars and the management of [[Incarnations]]. His leadership is characterized by a focus on directed power and preparation for conflict, though he has been accused of corruption, murder, and inciting war. He is the father of [[Leah]], his designated heiress, and [[Talos]], another potential successor. His rule is marked by complex relationships with subordinates like the [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]] Daiasus and various figures involved in the shifting power dynamics of the territories.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The Crimson Vault}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|His Majesty [[Zakareth]] the Sixth remains on the [[throne]] of [[Damasca]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c15">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 15</ref> The father of [[Talos]] previously served as the [[Damascan]] [[Successor]] before [[Leah]] was appointed to the role.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c15" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c18">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 18</ref> A warrior-king, [[Zakareth]] wields a large black shield and a gold-headed spear while clad in black and gold armor decorated with rubies.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 22</ref> He wears a tall, spiked crown of black and gold featuring a single [[ruby]] above his forehead.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22" /> Although legends claim the [[King of Damasca]] possesses a red eye capable of seeing spirits, hearts, or the future, [[Zakareth]] has only one good eye and covers the other with a black eyepatch.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22" /> The King is supported by the full might of [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22" />}}
